newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK weather - cloudy, rain, thunderstorms, max 27 C.
newsitem.headline: HK weather - cloudy, rain, thunderstorms, max 27 C.

text.p: It will be cloudy with occassional rain and scattered squally thunderstorms in the morning, the Royal Observatory said on Wednesday.
A thunderstorm warning was issued at 6.30 a.m., meaning scattered squally thunderstorms are expected during the next few hours.
The maximum temperature will be about 27 C.
At 7 a.m., the temperature was 23 C and the relative humidity 96 per cent, the observatory said.
